Pattern: sugary + N (drink, snack)
Examples: Sugary drinks fell by a fifth after the levy. | Sugary snacks sit at the height of a child's eye.

Pattern: fatty + N (cut, food)
Examples: The fatty cuts cook into the best stew. | Fatty food is cheap because fat is cheap.

Pattern: a wholesome + N (meal, diet)
Examples: A wholesome meal need not be dull. | The food is wholesome and entirely unfashionable.

Pattern: be moreish
Examples: The biscuits are dangerously moreish. | Salted nuts are moreish by design.

Pattern: eat in; không có tân ngữ
Examples: They eat in six nights a week. | Eating in is cheaper and takes longer.

Pattern: boil over; không có tân ngữ
Examples: The pan boiled over onto the hob. | Milk boils over the moment you turn away.

Pattern: stir in + N hoặc stir + N + in; tách được
Examples: Stir in the cream at the very end. | They stirred the herbs in off the heat.

Pattern: top up + N hoặc top + N + up; tách được
Examples: Top up the pan with hot water. | She topped the glasses up without asking.

Pattern: whip up + N hoặc whip + N + up; tách được
Examples: He whipped up a meal from the store cupboard. | She whipped something up for nine people.

Pattern: go off; không có tân ngữ
Examples: The milk goes off within a day in this heat. | Nothing had gone off, despite the power cut.

Pattern: live on + N; không tách được
Examples: They lived on potatoes and herring for a winter. | He lives on bread, cheese and tea.

Pattern: sit down to + N; không tách được
Examples: They sit down to a meal together every evening. | Nine of them sat down to dinner.

Pattern: pig out on + N
Examples: They pigged out on the leftovers. | He pigged out at the buffet and regretted it.

Pattern: danh từ số nhiều; teach/have good + table manners
Examples: Table manners were taught before reading in that house. | Table manners differ from one family to the next.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; keep/a + kitchen garden
Examples: The kitchen garden supplies half the vegetables. | A kitchen garden of nine beds feeds two households.

Pattern: be + a piece of cake
Examples: After the first loaf it was a piece of cake. | The exam was a piece of cake for her.

Pattern: be + the icing on the cake
Examples: The prize was the icing on the cake. | A warm evening was the icing on the cake.

Definition: chắc chắn dẫn đến thảm hoạ
Pattern: be + a recipe for disaster
Examples: Nine cooks and one hob is a recipe for disaster. | Cutting the inspections was a recipe for disaster.

Pattern: have a sweet tooth
Examples: He has a sweet tooth and the dentist to prove it. | She has a sweet tooth that no diet has survived.

Pattern: eat like a horse
Examples: The boy eats like a horse and weighs nothing. | After a shift on the boats they eat like horses.

Pattern: spice things up
Examples: One new face spiced things up at the committee. | They spiced things up by moving the market to the square.

Definition: nguồn thu chính, cần câu cơm
Pattern: be + sb's bread and butter
Examples: Repairs are the bread and butter of the business. | Weddings are their bread and butter.

Definition: thái độ bán tín bán nghi
Pattern: take sth with + a pinch of salt
Examples: Take the survey with a pinch of salt. | His version should be taken with a pinch of salt.

Pattern: the proof of the pudding + is in the eating
Examples: The proof of the pudding is in the eating, not the brochure. | They cited the trial as the proof of the pudding.

Pattern: cry over spilt milk
Examples: There is no point crying over spilt milk now. | She refused to cry over spilt milk and started again.
